summary: ansible/playbooks/renew-internal-tls.yml renews all ten internal_tls leaves in one play over proxmox:k8s:openbao, entering each consumer role at its own internal_tls task file so nothing about a leaf is restated; srvk8s4 drops out through the microk8s gate. One play rather than one per group because Ansible abandons the whole run when every host of a play fails (proved locally, and max_fail_percentage does not lift it); no serial, so the one-at-a-time guarantee stays with P1's throttled handlers; force_handlers so a host failing after issuance cannot drop its pending reload. Gate green, done-record appended, P3 gained the handler-phase timing constraint.
